pages.title: Authority Path
pages.text: Artifacts refine only through custom forge serializers—no crafting-table bypass. 73 recipes settle realm, forge tier, material multisets and success; failures wear materials honestly.

pages.title: Stations
pages.text: G1–G3 forges must be formed and commissioned. Success scales with proficiency and operational efficiency. JEI reuses server resolvePlan for real counts and outputs.

pages.title: Claim and Power
pages.text: Outputs enter claim, integrity and refine-layer flows. Broken artifacts reject mapped actives; powerScale hits damage. Full bags enqueue to the outbox.
